race.description: North West Events & SG O’Hara Furniture Zone (C1)
race.comment: NIELSEN PARK (3) was in the money two starts back at Forbes but couldn't back it up last time at Gunnedah when sent out favourite. Best figures measure up nicely, so willing to forgive. PUISSANCE POWER (4) went fast early over 1400m at Tamworth last time and defied all challengers to score. Will be up on the speed from the low draw and will take running down again. FABS CUZ (2) will appreciate the longer journey after finishing a solid fifth when resuming last start over 1400m at Tamworth. Is sure to have come on with that run under his belt and will appreciate stretching to the mile second-up. Bold showing anticipated. WHITTAKER (7) finds it hard to win with just the one career success which came quite a while back. Last start was fifth over 1400m at Dalby on August 11. Top three hope.
